zh.title: NAV Canada慶祝航空導航服務30週年
zh.summary: NAV Canada慶祝30週年，並介紹EXCDS數位化及空域監視技術發展。
body: NAV Canada慶祝30週年。該機構於1996年成立，與傳統由政府營運的航空導航服務模式有所不同。
成立兩年後，NAV Canada開發EXCDS電子飛航條系統。當時，航管人員以手寫註記的紙條管理飛航資料；EXCDS則將這些資料轉為數位形式。
2019年，太空型自動相依監視廣播（ADS-B）導入後，海洋及偏遠空域的監視能力也隨之改變。自1996年以來，投入加拿大航空導航系統的金額已超過35億美元。

en.title: NAV Canada Marks 30 Years of Air Navigation Services
en.summary: NAV Canada marks 30 years; over US$3.5 billion has been invested in Canada's air navigation system since 1996.
body: NAV Canada is marking 30 years. Established in 1996, the organization represented a departure from the traditional government-run model for air navigation services.

Two years after its creation, NAV Canada developed EXCDS, an electronic flight-strip system. At the time, air traffic controllers managed flight data on paper strips annotated by hand; EXCDS moved that information into the digital domain.

In 2019, space-based automatic dependent surveillance-broadcast (ADS-B) was introduced, transforming surveillance capabilities over oceanic and remote airspace. Since 1996, more than US$3.5 billion has been invested in Canada's air navigation system.
